<subject>Draft of Network Modernization Steering Committee Memo to David Larsen</subject>
<body>
David,

As we just discussed, this is the transition memo suggesting that you place a call to Stephen Mclaughlin.

As noted in the memo, we are still working through with the lawyers what leave status our employees would be required to take while serving on the private steering committee and the publicly funded regulatory working group. The answer to this question may determine their willingness to serve, in some cases.
</body>
